title: The first Celestin record date and who played
summary: They discuss the 1926 Celestin record date and its personnel, with Manuel Manetta on piano rather than Emma Barrett, then play Careless Love.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Did you play with Buddy Petit very much? Yeah, I played with them. I have these records over here, these old Celestan records. Do you remember that first date, the one that they had the black rag and the tuxedo rag and careless love? About when was that made?

Can you remember who else was on that? Who was the piano player? Can you remember? Some people say that Emma Barrett played and Manuel Moneta thinks he made one date. I think Manuel did. It was Manuel Moneta on that date. He thought he made those. He said one date. Yeah, he was. Somehow Emma didn't play that day. I don't know what happened. Those were those three records. We'll play that record and then if you have any remarks to make while the record, you can tell about how we're playing it or any time after. I'll just turn it on and this will pick it up I think alright too. This is the Careless Love. I mean this is the one where you use your bristles, slide bristles. dear
